issue_request: FHIR-8807 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core correction for the DSTU1 BaseResource artifact. It reported that Resource's StructureDefinition used the malformed base http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/ and approved a technical correction for DSTU2.
initial_application: No current Git commit mentions FHIR-8807, matching the Jira comment that the issue had already been fixed in an earlier SVN revision. The current Git-era Resource StructureDefinition was introduced in the 2021 new-build-core source rework with baseDefinition http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Base rather than the malformed empty URL.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini keeps Resource in the active resource-infrastructure build set and normative infrastructure package. The current CI build publishes StructureDefinition/Resource with baseDefinition StructureDefinition/Base and publishes StructureDefinition/Base itself as an abstract complex type. Community searches found no directly relevant Zulip or Confluence discussion for FHIR-8807.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source change is needed because the reported malformed base URL is gone, and removing the current Base parent would incorrectly undo the current valid root model.
